en: In the Name of ALLAH, the All-merciful, the All-compassionate

ar: أَلْحَمْدُ للّهِ وَالْحَمْدُ حَقُّهُ كَما يَسْتَحِقُّهُ حَمْداً كَثِيراً.
en: Praise belongs to ALLAH—and praise is His right, since He deserves it—abundant praise!
I seek refuge in Him from the evil of my soul,

ar: إنَّ النَّفْسَ لاَمَّارَةٌ بِالسُّوءِ إلاَّ ما رَحِمَ رَبِّي،
en: (for surely the soul commands to evil except as my Lord has mercy).

ar: وَأَعُوذُ بِهِ مِنْ شَرِّ الشَّيْطَانِ الَّذِي يَزِيدُنِي ذَنْباً إلَى ذَنْبِي،
en: I seek refuge in Him from the evil of SATAN who adds sins to my sin.

ar: وَأَحْتَرِزُ بِهِ مِنْ كُلِّ جَبَّار فاجِر، وَسُلْطان جآئر، وَعَدُوٍّ قاهِر.
en: I seek protection with Him from every wicked tyrant, unjust sovereign, and conquering enemy.
O ALLAH,

ar: اجْعَلْنِي مِنْ جُنْدِكَ فَإنَّ جُنْدَكَ هُمُ الْغالِبُونَ،
en: place me among Thy troops, for Thy troops—they are the victors,

ar: وَاجْعَلْنِي مِنْ حِزْبِكَ; فَإنَّ حِزْبَكَ هُمُ الْمُفْلِحُونَ،
en: place me in Thy party, for Thy party—they are the ones who prosper,

ar: وَاجْعَلْنِي مِنْ أَوْلِيآئِكَ; فَإنَّ أَوْلِيَاءَكَ لا خَوْفٌ عَلَيْهِمْ وَلا هُمْ يَحْزَنُونَ.
en: and place me among Thy friends, for Thy friends—no fear shall be upon them, nor shall they sorrow.

ar: أَللَّهُمَّ أَصْلِحْ لِي دِيْنِي فَإنَّهُ عِصْمَةُ أَمْرِي،
en: O ALLAH, set right for me my religion, for it is the preserving tie of my affair,

ar: وَأَصْلِحْ لِي آخِرَتِي فَإنَّهَا دارُ مَقَرِّي، وَإلَيْها مِنْ مُجاوَرَةِ اللِّئامِ مَفَرِّي،
en: set right for me my hereafter, for it is the abode of my permanent lodging and to it I flee from the neighborhood of the vile!

ar: وَاجْعَلِ الْحَياةَ زِيادَةً لِي فِي كُلِّ خَيْر،
en: Make life an increase for me in every good

ar: وَالْوَفاةَ رَاحَةً لِي مِنْ كُلِّ شَرٍّ.
en: AND death an ease for me from every evil!

ar: أَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّد خاتَمِ النَّبِيِّينَ وَتَمَامِ عِدَّةِ الْمُرْسَلِينَ
en: O ALLAH, bless MUHAMMAD, the Seal of the Prophets and the completion of the number of the envoys,
his Household, the good, the pure,
and his Companions, the distinguished,
and give me on the Tuesday three things: Leave

ar: لا تَدَعْ لِي ذَنْباً إلاَّ غَفَرْتَهُ،
en: no sin for me unless Thou forgivest it,
no grief unless Thou takest it away,
and no enemy unless Thou repellest him!
By means of 'in the name of ALLAH', the best of the Names,
in the name of ALLAH, Lord of earth and heaven,
I seek to repulse every hateful thing, the first of which is His anger,
and I seek to attract every lovable thing, the first of which is His good pleasure!
So seal me with forgiveness from Thee,
O Patron of beneficence!
